title: [Synthetic] Two-step calculator and formatter fixture
goal: Implement the existing staged fixture in two separately verifiable steps; keep the independent integration harness unchanged.

context.description: Reviewed two-file fixture contract; not a multi-step execution authorization.
Existing integration harness from the reviewed base.

decisions.decision: Accept the calculator first; pass its verified output to the formatter step.
decisions.rationale: Demonstrates a reusable, immutable predecessor result and final cumulative acceptance.
alternatives: Generate both files in one model call; already demonstrated, but not evidence of step recovery.

decisions.decision: Use trusted step-specific verifiers and the existing unchanged final harness.
decisions.rationale: The baseline placeholders both throw; the combined harness alone cannot accept step one.
alternatives: Let the model change the tests; rejected because acceptance must be independent.

criteria.text: Inclusive nearest-bound semantics verified by a trusted calculator-only harness; no other file changed.

steps.objective: Implement PairFormatter.Format(clamped,min,max) in invariant culture with exactly clamped [min,max]. Preserve accepted calculator bytes.

criteria.text: Independent formatter checks pass; predecessor calculator source remains byte-identical.
Unchanged combined harness builds offline without warnings and prints exactly HaMi pair acceptance passed; all guests removed, baseline unchanged.
